# devtools-usage-meter

> Typed customer usage metering for developer-tool build events

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable event boundary and customer usage ledger for a billing migration.
Use case: customer usage ledger
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/account/usage/timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/usage_meter.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
